opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Supreme Court of California denied. Reported below: Nos. 1092 and 1214, 25 Cal. 2d 697, 154 P. 2d 879; Nos. 1093 and 1215, 25 Cal. 2d 719, 154 P. 2d 891.
Robert W. Kenny, Attorney General of California, and Clarence A. Linn, Deputy Attorney General, for petitioner in Nos. 1092 and 1093. Assistant Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Shea, Messrs. Paul A. Sweeney and Walter J. Cummings, Jr. for the United States.

attorneys: Robert W. Kenny, Attorney General of California, and Clarence A. Linn, Deputy Attorney General, for petitioner in Nos. 1092 and 1093. Assistant Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Shea, Messrs. Paul A. Sweeney and Walter J. Cummings, Jr. for the United States.
